item.title: Funding for Cavan/Monaghan Sports Partnerships welcomed
item.description: A local TD has welcomed funding for the Cavan/Monaghan Sports Partnership. The funding forms part of a €12.66 million investment across 29 Local Sports Partnerships nationally, representing more than double the level of investment since 2018. €362,581 has been allocated for Cavan and €341,881 has been allocated for Monaghan. item.title: Man further remanded in jail over Cavan/Monaghan thefts
item.description: A 33-year-old man has been further remanded in custody in relation to a spate of thefts from businesses across Cavan, Louth, Meath and Monaghan. Luke Wall, with an address at Cois na hAbhann, Bonninconlon, Ballina, Co Mayo, appeared before Monaghan District Court. Judge Raymond Finnegan at Monaghan District Court was told that a book of evidence is awaited in this case. While at the school, Minister Naughton made she would "progress" the purpose built special education class in the school, so that it will be ready for students in September. item.title: Cllr Clerkin committed to returning 'Hive of Knowledge' to public view
item.description: A local councillor has reiterated his commitment to seeing the Hive of Knowledge artwork removed from storage and reinstated in a prominent public location in Monaghan Town. Cllr Pauric Clerkin confirmed that he has formally requested the MD Executive to progress this matter, emphasising the importance of restoring this significant piece of public art for the community to enjoy. item.title: Substantial investment by Penneys to benefit Cavan Town
item.description: Cavan-Monaghan TD Brendan Smith has welcomed today's announcement by Penneys that it will open a new store in Cavan Town. Located in Cavan Town's Main Street, the new store will occupy the existing Tesco site, which will move to a new location at Townparks. Penneys hopes to open the new store in Spring 2028. item.title: Co Cavan business woman wins national award
item.description: A Co Cavan business woman has been awarded 'Best Independent Weight Management Programme in Ireland' by the Acquisition International Business Excellence Awards. WeightMatters with Jenny Kinsella is an online weight-loss support system based in Co Cavan. The local woman told Northern Sound that she is "very grateful" to all members who have supported her down through the years.
